description: NaLaMgWO₆ is Pb (Zr_0.50 Ti_0.48) O_3-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.85 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-28°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.14 Å. La is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-3.00 Å. W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-28°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.08 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Mg, and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Mg, one La, and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, two equivalent La, and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Mg, two equivalent La, and one W atom.
